language.name: English
disclaimer: This result applies criteria from research to values measured from photos. It is not a diagnosis. A decision on any procedure needs an examination by a doctor.
region.jaw.name: Jaw
region.jaw.what: Width between the jaw angles compared with the width between the cheekbones
region.jaw.how: Predicted by a model from the whole face
region.chin.name: Chin
region.chin.what: Convexity angle of the profile through the forehead, below the nose and the chin (Legan angle)
region.chin.how: Measured from the outline of the profile photo
region.undereye.name: Under-eye
region.undereye.what: Depth of the tear trough, not including under-eye bags or dark circles
region.undereye.how: Graded by a model from each under-eye separately
region.undereye_left.name: Left under-eye
region.undereye_right.name: Right under-eye
region.nose_base.name: Nasal base
region.nose_base.what: Width of the nasal base compared with the distance between the inner eye corners
region.nose_base.how: Predicted by a model from the whole face
region.nose_dorsum.name: Nasal dorsum
region.nose_dorsum.what: Angle at which the nasal dorsum projects from the face (nasofacial angle)
region.nose_dorsum.how: Measured from the outline of the profile photo
grade.default.2+: At the level that research uses to consider a procedure
measure.facial_taperness.name: Facial taperness ratio
measure.legan_angle.name: Legan angle (facial convexity)
measure.alar_intercanthal_ratio.name: Alar base to intercanthal ratio
measure.nasofacial_angle.name: Nasofacial angle
reference.facial_taperness.male: No criterion for men yet, so only the value is shown
reference.legan_angle: Normal {ideal}°, acceptable range {low}–{high}°, one grade every {step}°
procedure.botox_masseter.name: Masseter Botox injection
procedure.botox_masseter.when: When the width comes from the masseter muscle
procedure.jaw_reduction.name: Jaw reduction surgery
procedure.jaw_reduction.when: When the width comes from the jawbone
procedure.chin_filler.name: Chin filler
procedure.chin_filler.when: Less invasive, for a mildly deficient chin
procedure.chin_implant.name: Chin implant
procedure.genioplasty.name: Sliding genioplasty
procedure.genioplasty.when: When the chin is also short or asymmetric, or sits far back
procedure.undereye_filler.name: Under-eye filler
procedure.undereye_filler.when: The tear trough is as deep as the level the trial used to enrol participants
procedure.alar_reduction.name: Alar base reduction
procedure.alar_reduction.when: When the nasal base is wider than the range Thai people prefer
procedure.nose_filler.name: Nose filler

procedure.rhinoplasty_implant.name: Augmentation rhinoplasty
procedure.rhinoplasty_implant.when: Augmentation with an implant lasts longer
note.jaw_cause_unknown: Jaw width can come from the masseter muscle, the jawbone or fat, which a photo cannot tell apart. Width from fat suits neither option, and palpation or an X-ray is needed first to know which approach fits.
note.chin_check_occlusion: Check the bite first: a retruded chin linked to a bite problem, and a chin that is short vertically, are contraindications for an implant. A protruding upper jaw or front teeth can make the angle larger even with a normal chin.
note.chin_check_mandible: A chin that sits far back may come from the whole lower jaw. Check the bite and take a lateral skull X-ray (cephalogram) before deciding.
note.undereye_scope: The system assesses only the depth of the tear trough, not under-eye bags or dark circles.
note.nose_base_indications: Alar base reduction has several indications, such as flared nostrils, a wide distance between the alae or a wide nostril base, which need a photo from below the nose. A frontal photo cannot tell these cases apart.
note.nose_filler_vision_risk: The nose is the site with the most reported cases of vision loss after filler injection.
withheld.male_jaw_no_criterion: There is no jaw criterion for men yet, so only the measured value is shown.
withheld.distance_unknown: An uploaded photo has an unknown camera distance, which can make the nasal base look wider or narrower, so only the measured value is shown.
withheld.age_under_18: Procedures are not shown for people under 18.
withheld.age_21_or_under: The research studied people over 21, so under-eye procedures are not shown.
withheld.no_procedure_at_grade: This grade has not reached the level that research uses to consider a procedure.
quality.no_face: Keep your face in the frame
quality.multiple_faces: Keep only one face in the picture
quality.face_too_small: Come a little closer to the camera
quality.too_close: Move a little further from the camera
quality.smiling: Relax your face, close your mouth and do not smile
quality.eyes_closed: Keep your eyes open as usual
quality.hair_occlusion: Tie your hair back so the jaw and under-eyes show
quality.profile_invalid: Turn fully to the side so the forehead, nose, mouth and chin are clear
quality.model_not_ready: This part is not available yet because the model has not finished training
ui.app.name: Facial proportions
ui.lang.label: Language
ui.health.down: Cannot connect to the api yet, perhaps because the api is not running on this computer. Start the api, then press Try again.
ui.home.title: Compare facial proportions with criteria from research
ui.home.lead: This system measures facial proportions from a frontal photo and a profile photo, then compares them with criteria from research.
ui.home.point_regions: It looks at four regions: the jaw, the chin, the under-eyes and the nose.
ui.home.point_not_diagnosis: The result applies criteria from research to values measured from photos. It is not a diagnosis.
ui.home.point_local: Photos are processed on this computer and are not kept. Close this page or press Start over, and all photos are gone.
ui.home.age_invalid: Enter the age as a whole number from 0 to 120
ui.home.sex_missing: Choose a sex, female or male
ui.frontal.title: Frontal photo
ui.frontal.intro: Use a photo that faces the camera straight on, shows the whole face and has only one face in it.
ui.frontal.tip_hair: Tie your hair back so the jaw and under-eyes show
ui.frontal.tip_face: Relax your face, close your mouth and do not smile
ui.profile.title: Profile photo
ui.profile.intro: Use a photo turned fully to the side. Left or right is fine; the system flips it for you.
ui.profile.tip_eyes: Look straight ahead at eye level
ui.profile.tip_mouth: Close your mouth with relaxed lips
ui.profile.tip_wall: Stand in front of a plain wall
ui.profile.skip_note: Without a profile photo, the chin and the nasal dorsum cannot be assessed.
ui.profile.guide_note: Keep your head inside the profile outline. A person turned to the side cannot see the screen.
ui.profile.countdown: Take the photo after a {seconds}-second countdown
ui.profile.check_photo: Check that you turned fully to the side and that the forehead, nose, mouth and chin are clear, then press Use this photo, or Retake.
ui.capture.choose_file: Choose a photo from the computer
ui.camera.video_label: Camera view, flipped like a mirror. The photo taken is not flipped.
ui.camera.low_resolution: This camera gives {width}×{height} px. A height below {min} px is not detailed enough at 1 m. Use a camera of 1080p or more, or choose another camera.
ui.camera.unsupported: This browser cannot open the camera from this page. Open http://localhost:8000 in Chrome, Edge or Safari, or choose a photo from the computer instead.
ui.camera.denied: The page is not allowed to use the camera yet. Please allow the camera for this page, then press Turn on the camera again, or choose a photo from the computer instead.
ui.camera.not_found: No camera was found on this computer. Connect a camera and press Turn on the camera again, or choose a photo from the computer instead.
ui.camera.overconstrained: This camera does not support what the page asks for. Choose another camera and press Turn on the camera again, or choose a photo from the computer instead.
ui.camera.in_use: The camera could not be turned on. Another program may be using it. Close that program and press Turn on the camera again.
ui.camera.failed: The camera could not be turned on. Press Turn on the camera again, or choose a photo from the computer instead.
ui.guide.auto_note: The photo is taken by itself once every check has passed for about {seconds} seconds in a row, or you can press Take photo at any time.
ui.guide.hold: Good, hold still, taking the photo
ui.guide.unavailable: The pose helper could not be loaded. Set your pose with the list below and press Take photo yourself.
ui.guide.pose.yaw_positive: turn back a little to your own right
ui.guide.pose.yaw_negative: turn back a little to your own left
ui.guide.pose.roll_positive: tilt your head a little toward your left shoulder
ui.guide.pose.roll_negative: tilt your head a little toward your right shoulder
ui.upload.not_jpeg_png: This file is not a JPEG or PNG image. Convert it to JPEG first, then choose it again.
ui.upload.unreadable: This file cannot be read as an image. Choose another photo, or convert it to JPEG first.
ui.review.title: Check the photos before sending
ui.review.intro: Check that both photos are usable, then press Analyze. To change a photo, press Back. The photos go only to the api on this computer.
ui.review.no_frontal: There is no frontal photo yet. Take or choose one before sending.
ui.review.no_profile: There is no profile photo, so the chin and the nasal dorsum cannot be assessed.
ui.review.analyzing: Analyzing, this may take a moment
ui.review.shrinking: The photo is larger than the api accepts. Shrinking it and sending it again.
ui.review.cancelled: The analysis was cancelled. Press Analyze to send again.
ui.error.bad_image: This file cannot be read as an image. Go back and choose or take a new photo.
ui.error.too_large: The photo is larger than the api accepts even after shrinking. Go back and choose a smaller photo.
ui.error.invalid: The page sent incomplete data, which is a fault of the page itself. Reload the page and try again.
ui.error.server: The api has a problem or is not running. Check that the api is running, then press Try again.
ui.error.timeout: The api took too long, so the page stopped waiting. Press Try again; there is no need to take new photos.
